name: Pure Doll
source:
Main character gets a female type bioroid from some mad scientist. She is built as a real girl, but lacks human emotions. That will need to be fixed in three weeks time.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公从一名疯狂科学家处得到一具女性型生化人。她被制造得与真实女孩无异，却缺乏人类情感。这一点必须在3周内修复。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
